summary: A tight two-player card game where you build ascending number runs in five (or six) colored expeditions, weighing when to commit to a color against the risk that low investment leaves you in the red. Turns are quick and simple but every discard is a tense decision because it can hand your opponent exactly the card they need.
praised: Elegant push-your-luck tension on when to start an expedition
Tight two-player duel with real bite despite simple rules
Great as a filler or gateway two-player game
criticised: Can feel too luck-dependent, especially in the draw
Limited long-term variety once you know the strategy
Some find it too abstract/dry compared to Knizia's other designs

interaction.kind: card denial via shared discard piles

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: Whoever manages their expedition investments best, avoiding negative-scoring colors while denying useful discards to the opponent, wins
